thread:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — Customer Atlas is asking to onboard a private deployment (VPC + on-prem option) by end of Q2. Need cross-team gating and clear launch criteria. Who can own the dependency map?
Marco (Runtime): I can draft a runtime compatibility checklist. Main unknown: the customer's model size + quantization requirements. We should confirm whether we can serve their fp16 or need int8 quantized variants.
Elena (Infra): Infra checklist: VPC peering, dedicated subnet, NAT/egress policy, and staging hardware reservation. Also need a clarified SLA for dedicated capacity.
Ravi (Security): From security side: KMS/HSM keywrap requirements, minimum FIPS profile, and audit log retention (90d vs 365d). Also need customer legal signoff timeframe.
Jared (SRE): Can we get a staging cluster with the same sizing? I want to run load and failover tests. Also need an oncall rotation for the first 30 days after launch.
Priya (PM): Good. Proposal: split into onboarding milestones — 1) Requirements & contract, 2) Staging validation, 3) Canary + rollback plan, 4) GA. Target dates in thread.
Sophie (Product Ops): I'll own milestone scheduling and vendor onboarding. Tentative dates: requirements complete by 2165200000, staging validation by 2165400000, canary mid-2165480000, GA around 2165600000. Are those realistic?
Marco (Runtime): Staging validation depends on model artifact delivery. If we get artifacts by 2165200000 we can validate in 2 weeks. Also need to decide on default fallback model if quantization breaks quality.
Ravi (Security): For KMS/HSM integration, procurement lead time is 3 weeks if we use cloud KMS. On-prem HSM will add 6-8 weeks. Need customer preference ASAP.
Elena (Infra): Note: VLAN + subnet setup for their on-prem gateway requires coordination with network team and their infra contact. I'll put a checklist item: "network test harness".
Priya (PM): Launch criteria draft (vote):
- Performance: p95 inference latency <= 120ms at target QPS
- Correctness: Regression on our eval suite <= 1% delta
- Security: KMS integration complete + audit logs in observability
- Reliability: Successful rolling canary with no SEV>2 in 48h
- Ops: Oncall/RCA runbook present
If we agree, we can make these gating checkpoints.
Marco (Runtime): Agree with latency/correctness. Add: memory/KV cache sizing validated for sequence lengths up to 2k tokens.
Jared (SRE): Add: chaos test (node kill + network partition) during staging with defined success metrics.
Ravi (Security): Suggest adding a pen-test window before GA or at least a threat model review signoff.
Sophie (Product Ops): I'll add these to the milestone docs and create an owner column. Who owns the canary rollback policy?
Marco (Runtime): Runtime + SRE should co-own rollback policy. My initial rollback plan: automatic fallback to a smaller compatible model + capacity re-route to hosted instances. Will document thresholds.
Priya (PM): OK — action items: @Marco write runtime checklist; @Elena share infra network stub and staging reqs; @Ravi confirm KMS/HSM choices with customer; @Jared schedule chaos/runbook; @Sophie consolidate dates + owners. I'll push milestone PR by EOD.
Elena (Infra): One more constraint: our staging quota for dedicated GPUs is low in region eu-west1 the week of mid-2165400000. We may need to shift staging earlier or request burst capacity.
Priya (PM): Noted. Sophie — can you check cost for burst reserve vs shifting dates?
Sophie (Product Ops): Will do. Also creating a short checklist to share with Atlas (customer) so they know hold-ups.
Marco (Runtime): Drafted a small config snippet for the canary policy we'll use:
```
canary_policy:
  percent_traffic: 5
  duration_hours: 48
  rollback_triggers:
    latency_p95_ms: 200
    error_rate_percent: 2
```
I'll attach to the PR.
Priya (PM): Perfect. If we can get artifact delivery and KMS preference this week we can keep Q2 target. Thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: Deployment window for canary opens in 2 weeks. Schedule with `@jared` to lock the oncall. :robot_face:
Jared (SRE): Acknowledge. I'll block the calendar and draft the runbook.
Ravi (Security): I'll follow up with legal and the customer's security contact tomorrow.
Priya (PM): End of thread for now — will update after PR. :thumbsup:
